maria_p: Noticed intermittent hang during shutdown in one FastAPI service. We keep a single httpx.AsyncClient on app.state; sometimes uvicorn shutdown hangs and we get 'RuntimeError: Event loop is closed'.

maria_p: Minimal repro pasted below — happens after a few concurrent background tasks.

maria_p: ```py
# startup
async def startup():
    app.state.client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10.0)

# background task
async def bg_task():
    r = await app.state.client.get(url)
    return r.text

# shutdown
async def shutdown():
    await app.state.client.aclose()
```

alex: I hit something similar when tests spawn their own loop (pytest-asyncio) and we reuse a global client. Feels like loop/transport lifecycle mismatch.

jamie: Does the hang line up with calling aclose from a different loop than the one that created the transport? AsyncClient's sockets/transport are loop-bound.

maria_p: Likely. Background tasks run on the app loop, but our shutdown handler sometimes executes in a different thread (gunicorn + uvloop interplay). Not deterministic.

sam_sdk: Which httpx version? There were shutdown fixes around 0.23 -> 0.24. Also contextvar/loop shenanigans if AsyncClient is stored on module globals.

maria_p: Using httpx==0.24.1. Reproes locally with uvicorn[standard] + uvloop.

kyle: FastAPI recommends creating the client in the lifespan event and closing there. Try making client per-process in lifespan rather than module-global.

maria_p: Did that — still saw one hang where send blocked. The stack showed httpx._transports.asyncio.AsyncioBackend.send stuck.

alex: Workaround: cancel background tasks before closing client, or call client.close() via run_until_complete on the same loop. Messy hacks though.

jamie: Product asks: 1) SDK should ship an async context manager helper so users don't keep module-global clients. 2) Add docs/examples for safe reuse with FastAPI/uvicorn.

sam_sdk: Agreed. Also add typing for AsyncClient usage so mypy catches misuse (storing on sync objects, etc.).

maria_p: Short-term I used an AsyncExitStack in lifespan to cancel tasks then aclose; this reduced occurrences.

devex-bot: Note added to backlog: DEVEX-412 async client lifecycle example + SDK async context manager.

kyle: Also add a small reproducible test in examples repo running with uvloop & pytest-asyncio to catch regressions.

alex: I can PR a FastAPI lifespan example + a "Common shutdown pitfalls" section with snippets.

maria_p: Will paste failing trace & tiny repro into the PR comment.

maria_p: ```
RuntimeError: Event loop is closed
  File "site-packages/httpx/_transports/asyncio.py", line 315, in send
    await sock.send(...)
  File "asyncio/selector_events.py", line ..., in _sock_sendall
    raise RuntimeError('Event loop is closed')
```

jamie: Also consider an SDK helper `create_async_client_for_lifespan()` that returns a correctly wired AsyncClient and docs so teams avoid pitfalls.

sam_sdk: I'll prototype types + contextmanager: `class RedwoodClient: async def __aenter__...` with tests.

maria_p: Thanks — ping me if you want a reproducer, happy to help.

alex: Add CI job to run the example with uvloop enabled and run the shutdown sequence to catch regressions. :thumbsup:
